title: tecoma pandorana
intro: Tecoma pandorana, commonly known as the Yellow Trumpetbush, is a flowering plant species native to Australia. It is a shrub-like plant known for its bright yellow flowers, which have been used in traditional medicine for various purposes. The health benefits of Tecoma pandorana include its potential anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in the treatment of various ailments such as fever, colds, and sore throats. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
